newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma says signs $120 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Gruma says signs $120 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Mexico's Gruma SA de CV, a maker of tortillas and corn flour with interests in the United States and Central America, said on Thursday that it had secured a $120 miillion syndicated loan to refinance debt.
"Today we concluded the signing of a line of credit for $120 million, and the funds will be received today," Javier Velez, chief financial officer of Gruma, told Reuters.
The lead bank on the deal is Bank of America, but 17 other U.S., Canadian, European, Asian and Latin American banks participated, Velez said.
The loan is for three years without a specific guarantee at a rate of Libor plus 1.25 percent, Vlez said.
Gruma, which controls Grupo Industrial Maseca SA de CV, has a total of $340 million in consolidated debt.
